project_type: Vite 6 + React 18 + TypeScript SPA with Convex backend
build_system: Vite with tsc type-checking. Node v20 available at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin. npm for package management. Convex for backend (requires npx convex dev to regenerate types but we work with source files directly).
test_framework: No test framework currently configured in the project
test_command: No test command - verify via TypeScript compilation: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/water-level && npx tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript types. 2. Run vite build to verify the frontend builds. Note: Convex type generation (npx convex dev) cannot be run without Convex credentials, so we verify source correctness via manual inspection and tsc on source files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: convex/_generated/ contains auto-generated types. These are regenerated by 'npx convex dev'. We cannot run this in sandbox but we can verify our source files are correct TypeScript.
environment_constraints: Node v20 available. npm available. No Convex CLI credentials (cannot run npx convex dev to regenerate _generated/ types). The _generated/api.d.ts references some removed files (auth.ts, favorites.ts, http.ts) that no longer exist. OneSignal SDK needs to be installed as npm dependency for frontend.
contribution_requirements: Standard PR workflow. Build must pass (tsc + vite build).
key_patterns: Convex backend: actions for external API calls, mutations for DB writes, internalMutation/internalAction for server-only functions. Frontend: TanStack Router for routing, ConvexHttpClient for data fetching, shadcn/ui components (Dialog, Switch, Button), Radix UI primitives, lucide-react icons via IconLibrary.tsx wrapper, Tailwind CSS for styling.
directory_structure: Root: vite.config.ts, package.json, netlify.toml, index.html. convex/: schema.ts, stations.ts, cameras.ts, crons.ts, waterLevelData.ts, waterLevelHistory.ts, waterLevelSummaries.ts, sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts, sync/stationUpdater.ts, sync/cameraUpdater.ts. src/: components/ (layout.tsx, ui/, icons/), hooks/, lib/ (convexClient.ts, queryClient.ts, FilterContext.tsx, utils.ts), routes/. public/: PWA icons. netlify/: functions/.
